Toucan 1.0.28

  • Emails from a client’s shared mailbox are now saved in folders named as in Outlook, such as Email/Inbox, Email/Inbox/Tax and Email/Sent Items, so Claude can see where each one came from. A name Toucan already knows in a folder’s name, such as a client’s name or an email address, is replaced by its token. Emails fetched before stay where they are.
  • In a mailbox’s settings, Every folder now means the whole mailbox, Sent Items and Archive included, and Choose… lists all of its folders. Deleted Items, Junk Email, Drafts and Outbox are never read. A client already on Every folder fetches its other folders back to its start date the first time it checks, in batches of 50. Every Mac that fetches a shared client’s mailbox needs this version.
  • Claude Desktop can now list just one folder of a client’s files, or only the files since a given day, so asking about “today’s emails” or “the Tax folder” is quicker for a client with many files. If Claude doesn’t seem to use it, choose Install Again… on Settings › Extensions.

Toucan 1.0.27

  • The menu bar menu is now a panel, laid out like the battery menu: each row’s detail sits in grey at the right, and Active Project and To Do open in place. The team line and To Do show only when there’s something to say. Active Project holds the clients and the active client’s folders and Recordings. Restore File… is on each Tokenised row, and Toucan locks from the padlock on the Drop bar or the window.
  • A recording a colleague makes for a shared client now shows in that client’s Recordings as soon as OneDrive brings it to your Mac, without reopening the page.
  • A transcript waiting to be checked is now on every Mac’s To Do, not only the Mac that recorded it, without a count of flags on the others. Whoever checks and tokenises it first takes it off To Do on every Mac. Every Mac needs this version for that.
  • A transcript changed after it was tokenised, by hand or by Re-apply Corrections, is to be checked again.
  • While a transcript waits to be checked, its panel tints orange each word the check will ask about. Point at one to see why, and press ⌥Tab to move to the next.
  • Adding a transcript correction to a long transcript no longer freezes Toucan, and the check itself is much quicker.
  • Tokenised transcripts now stay on a client’s Originals list with the Tokenised pill, as other files do.

Toucan 1.0.26

  • Toucan is quicker. Saving changes, such as adding to Global Keep or Edit as List…, no longer pauses the app for a second or two, and the map on Structure scrolls more smoothly.
  • In a team, Toucan now catches up with the team’s latest changes when it opens and when your Mac wakes, before it tokenises anything. While it does, the menu bar icon shows turning arrows, and the menu, the Drop bar and Settings › Team say so. Without an internet connection it carries on with what it last had.
  • In Settings › Team › Members, each Mac shows when it last caught up with the team, and admins get a To Do row when a Mac is behind. A Mac shows this once it has updated to this version.
  • A team sync that stops partway no longer loses the files it had already downloaded.
  • An email blocked for its text encoding now says which part or header, the encoding it claims and what would read it, never the text itself.
  • Emails whose text says it is UTF-8 but isn’t quite (common with some email programs) are now tokenised instead of blocked. The Tokenised copy is written as proper UTF-8.
